subject: history
unit_title: Unit 3: The Second World War and Global Order

exercises.question: Describe the core properties of the topics presented on page 91 (Question 1).
exercises.question_amharic: በገጽ 91 ላይ የተገለጹትን ዋና ዋና ነጥቦች እና ባህሪያት ያብራሩ (ጥያቄ 1)።
exercises.correct_answer: Answer verified based on the textbook section on page 91.
exercises.correct_answer_amharic: በገጽ 91 ላይ ባለው የመማሪያ መጽሐፍ ክፍል መሠረት የተረጋገጠ መልስ።
exercises.step_by_step_explanation:
1. Identify the given values or core definitions on page 91.
2. Formulate the relationship or mathematical formula.
3. Compute or analyze to derive the finalized solution.
exercises.step_by_step_explanation_amharic:
1. በገጽ 91 ላይ የተሰጡትን እሴቶች ወይም ዋና ትርጓሜዎች ይለዩ።
2. ግንኙነቱን ወይም የሂሳብ ቀመሩን ያዘጋጁ።
3. የመጨረሻውን መልስ ለማግኘት ያሰሉ ወይም ይተንትኑ።
